name: Turn Off Site Comments
author: Mikin Chauhan

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to effortlessly deactivate all comment features throughout your entire website. With a simple activation process, there’s no need for complicated settings or extra coding. Enjoy a cleaner user experience and eliminate unnecessary distractions by turning off comments site-wide. Perfect for blogs, business sites, or any platform where comments are not needed, this plugin helps streamline your website management and enhances your site’s focus.

Key Features:
1. Easy Activation: Get started quickly with no coding or settings required.
2. Site-Wide Control: Disable comments across all posts and pages instantly.
3. Improved User Experience: Create a more focused environment for your visitors.
4. Lightweight Solution: Minimal impact on site performance.

This is the latest version, originally developed by @mikinc860
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Downloaded “disable-entire-comment.zip” Folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Or, UNZIP “disable-entire-comment.zip” folder and Upload disable-entire-comment on the “wp-content/plugins/” folder via FTP or Copy and
    Paste on your Local Computer
